title: Berland Elections
statementMd:
The elections to Berland parliament are happening today. Voting is in full swing!

Totally there are $*n*$ candidates, they are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. Based on election results $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) top candidates will take seats in the parliament.

After the end of the voting the number of votes for each candidate is calculated. In the resulting table the candidates are ordered by the number of votes. In case of tie (equal number of votes) they are ordered by the time of the last vote given. The candidate with ealier last vote stands higher in the resulting table.

So in the resulting table candidates are sorted by the number of votes (more votes stand for the higher place) and if two candidates have equal number of votes they are sorted by the time of last vote (earlier last vote stands for the higher place).

There is no way for a candidate with zero votes to take a seat in the parliament. So it is possible that less than $*k*$ candidates will take a seat in the parliament.

In Berland there are $*m*$ citizens who can vote. Each of them will vote for some candidate. Each citizen will give a vote to exactly one of $*n*$ candidates. There is no option "against everyone" on the elections. It is not accepted to spoil bulletins or not to go to elections. So each of $*m*$ citizens will vote for exactly one of $*n*$ candidates.

At the moment $*a*$ citizens have voted already ($1 ≤ *a* ≤ *m*$). This is an open election, so for each citizen it is known the candidate for which the citizen has voted. Formally, the $*j*$-th citizen voted for the candidate $*g*_{*j*}$. The citizens who already voted are numbered in chronological order; i.e. the $(*j* + 1)$-th citizen voted after the $*j*$-th.

The remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens will vote before the end of elections, each of them will vote for one of $*n*$ candidates.

Your task is to determine for each of $*n*$ candidates one of the three possible outcomes:

- a candidate will be elected to the parliament regardless of votes of the remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens;
- a candidate has chance to be elected to the parliament after all $*n*$ citizens have voted;
- a candidate has no chances to be elected to the parliament regardless of votes of the remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*n*$, $*k*$, $*m*$ and $*a*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *a* ≤ *m*$) — the number of candidates, the number of seats in the parliament, the number of Berland citizens and the number of citizens who already have voted.

The second line contains a sequence of $*a*$ integers $*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*a*}$ ($1 ≤ *g*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$), where $*g*_{*j*}$ is the candidate for which the $*j*$-th citizen has voted. Citizens who already voted are numbered in increasing order of voting times.

## Output

Print the sequence consisting of $*n*$ integers $*r*_{1}, *r*_{2}, ..., *r*_{*n*}$ where:

- $*r*_{*i*} = 1$ means that the $*i*$-th candidate is guaranteed to take seat in the parliament regardless of votes of the remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens;
- $*r*_{*i*} = 2$ means that the $*i*$-th candidate has a chance to take a seat in the parliament, i.e. the remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens can vote in such a way that the candidate will take a seat in the parliament;
- $*r*_{*i*} = 3$ means that the $*i*$-th candidate will not take a seat in the parliament regardless of votes of the remaining $*m* - *a*$ citizens.
statementZhMd:
伯兰议会的选举正在今天举行。投票正如火如荼地进行着！

总共有 $*n*$ 名候选人，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。根据选举结果，排名前 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）的候选人将获得议会席位。

投票结束后，将统计每位候选人获得的票数。在最终排名表中，候选人按照得票数排序。如果出现平票（得票数相同），则按照最后一张选票投出的时间排序。最后一张选票投出时间更早的候选人在排名表中的位置更高。

因此，在最终排名表中，候选人首先按照得票数排序（得票数越多，排名越高）；如果两名候选人的得票数相同，则按照最后一张选票投出的时间排序（最后一张选票投出时间更早，排名越高）。

得票数为零的候选人不可能获得议会席位。因此，最终可能少于 $*k*$ 名候选人获得席位。

伯兰有 $*m*$ 名公民可以投票。每个人都会投给某位候选人。每位公民恰好会给 $*n*$ 名候选人中的一人投票。选举中没有“反对所有人”的选项，也不允许弃票、毁坏选票或不参加选举。因此，$*m*$ 名公民中的每一人都会恰好给一名候选人投票。

目前已有 $*a*$ 名公民完成投票（$1 ≤ *a* ≤ *m*$）。这是一次公开选举，因此已知每位公民投给了哪位候选人。形式化地说，第 $*j*$ 名公民投给了候选人 $*g*_{*j*}$。已经投票的公民按照投票时间的先后编号；也就是说，第 $(*j* + 1)$ 名公民在第 $*j*$ 名公民之后投票。

剩余的 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民将在选举结束前投票，他们中的每个人都会给 $*n*$ 名候选人中的一人投票。

你的任务是确定每位 $*n*$ 名候选人属于以下三种结果中的哪一种：

- 无论剩余 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民如何投票，该候选人都将当选进入议会；
- 在所有 $*n*$ 名公民完成投票后，该候选人有机会当选进入议会；
- 无论剩余 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民如何投票，该候选人都不可能当选进入议会。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$、$*m*$ 和 $*a*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *a* ≤ *m*$）——候选人的数量、议会席位的数量、伯兰公民的数量以及已经投票的公民数量。

第二行包含一个由 $*a*$ 个整数组成的序列 $*g*_{1}, *g*_{2}, ..., *g*_{*a*}$（$1 ≤ *g*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$），其中 $*g*_{*j*}$ 表示第 $*j*$ 名公民投票支持的候选人。已经投票的公民按照投票时间递增的顺序编号。

## 输出格式

输出一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的序列 $*r*_{1}, *r*_{2}, ..., *r*_{*n*$}，其中：

- $*r*_{*i*} = 1$ 表示无论剩余 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民如何投票，第 $*i*$ 名候选人都必定会获得议会席位；
- $*r*_{*i*} = 2$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名候选人有机会获得议会席位，即剩余 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民可以采用某种投票方式，使该候选人获得议会席位；
- $*r*_{*i*} = 3$ 表示无论剩余 $*m* - *a*$ 名公民如何投票，第 $*i*$ 名候选人都不会获得议会席位。
